title: Submit a record and receive a research score
description: This verifies that a user can enter numeric table values in Paste a record, submit them, and see a research score result.
category: Paste a record research score submit path

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Paste a record tab
Fill valid numeric values into the record fields
Submit the record for scoring
Verify a research score is displayed
Verify the submitted record is recognized as scored

title: Start a research score from pasted numeric table values
description: This verifies that a user can open the scoring flow, enter a full set of numeric table values, and submit them to receive a research score result.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the More menu
Click the Paste a record option
Fill the numeric table fields with valid values
Submit the table for scoring
Verify a research score result is displayed
Verify the submitted record is reflected in the scoring result view

title: Recognize the research-only framing on load
description: This verifies that opening the home page shows the persistent research-only disclaimer and non-medical-use framing in the app chrome.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the research-only advisory is visible in the header
Verify the non-diagnostic disclaimer is visible in the footer

title: Switch from Story to Data and preserve tab state
description: This verifies that a user can move from the Story view to the Data view and see the active content change accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Story tab
Click the Data tab
Verify the Data view content is displayed
Verify the active tab highlight reflects the Data tab

title: Keep the disclaimer visible while browsing the page
description: This verifies that the research-only disclaimer remains present after scrolling through the home page content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page
Verify the research-only advisory is still visible in the header
Verify the non-diagnostic disclaimer is still visible in the footer

title: Generate the locked PDF report after scoring
description: This verifies that a user can complete scoring, provide identity details, and generate the locked PDF report from the result flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the More menu
Click the Paste a record option
Fill the numeric table fields with valid values
Submit the table for scoring
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill a valid date of birth into the date of birth field
Generate the locked PDF report
Verify a locked PDF report option is displayed
Verify the research score result remains visible
